description: The bar chart compares the accuracy (%) of a model across different configurations on two datasets, PHEME and PolitiFact, with the y-axis representing accuracy in percentage and the x-axis showing various model variants. On the PHEME dataset, the model achieves the highest accuracy of 89.84% with the "Ours" configuration, followed by 88.80% for "w/o select," 87.34% for "w/o emotion," and 87.17% for "w/o cognition." The lowest accuracy on this dataset is 80.10% for "w/o text." On the PolitiFact dataset, the model again performs best with the "Ours" configuration at 90.57%, followed by 89.62% for "w/o select," 87.74% for "w/o cognition," 85.85% for "w/o comments," 84.91% for "w/o emotion," and 83.02% for "w/o text." The bars are color-coded to distinguish between the configurations, with "Ours" consistently showing the highest accuracy in both datasets, while "w/o text" shows the lowest. The chart demonstrates that the inclusion of all components in the model leads to the highest performance, with the removal of different components resulting in varying degrees of accuracy reduction.
